predictions.explanation:
Multiple post‑hoc reports indicate that OpenAI’s actual revenue for calendar year 2023 was well above $1 billion, around $1.6 billion:

- A January 4, 2024 Financial Express summary of Finbold data states that OpenAI "surpassed the one billion dollar mark for the first time and reached $1.6 billion in revenue" in the full year 2023, describing this as a year‑over‑year increase of about 700% from roughly $200 million in 2022. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/digital-transformation-openai-clocked-1-6-billion-worth-revenue-in-2023-3355681/?utm_source=openai))
- Coverage in outlets like The Hans India and Open Source For You similarly report that OpenAI "crossed the $1 billion mark" and reached about **$1.6 billion in revenue in 2023**, attributing the growth primarily to ChatGPT. ([thehansindia.com](https://www.thehansindia.com/technology/tech-news/openai-achieves-financial-milestone-in-2023-revenue-explodes-700-report-849029?utm_source=openai))
- The Daily Star, summarizing reporting from The Information, notes that OpenAI "surpassed $1.6 billion in annual revenue as of the end of 2023," up from about $1.3 billion as of mid‑October 2023. ([d11.thedailystar.net](https://d11.thedailystar.net/tech-startup/news/openai-surpasses-16-bln-annual-revenue-report-3508976?utm_source=openai))
- TechTimes likewise reports that OpenAI’s earnings for 2023 reached **about $1.6 billion**, again citing The Information’s sources. ([techtimes.com](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/300228/20240101/openai-thrives-amid-ceo-turmoil-annual-revenue-skyrockets-20-surpass.htm?utm_source=openai))

Jason’s claim in September 2023 was that OpenAI was "on track to generate $1 billion in revenue in 2023." The realized figure (~$1.6B) clearly exceeds that threshold and is in the same order of magnitude; the core prediction—that 2023 revenue would be around or above $1B—was therefore borne out by subsequent data. On that basis, the prediction is best classified as **right**.

predictions.grok_explanation: OpenAI's full-year 2023 revenue was approximately $1-2 billion, aligning with the prediction. Reliable reports confirm rapid growth: The Information (Dec 2023) noted $1.6B annualized revenue (monthly run rate x12), up from $1.3B in Oct; Epoch AI reports $2B ARR end-2023. Estimates of total 2023 revenue include $1.6B (Finbold, early 2024 reports), $2B (SaaStr), $2.2B (GetLatka). Given the 'approximately $1 billion' phrasing and on-track status in Sep 2023 (when ARR was ~$1B), the prediction proved accurate as revenue exceeded $1B for the year.
